BiblicalUsage: Irad is a son of Enoch in the line of Cain, named in the first genealogy. In Genesis 4:18 unto Enoch is born Irad, and Irad begat Mehujael, and Mehujael begat Methusael, and Methusael begat Lamech.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Irad's name is there to trace the line of Cain: four generations from Enoch to Lamech, and the line runs to murder.
RelatedPeople: Enoch; Lamech, Son of Methusael; Cain
